text:
deploy-bot: Kicking off rollout v2026.03.22-artemis. Feature flag 'model-route-v3' toggling: start canary at 3% global, pin model=llama-2-13b-q4a, canary cohort = internal-beta. Monitoring: p50/p95/p99, 5xx, 429s, KV hit rate. Release window 02:00-05:00 UTC.
jen: On it. I'll watch regions separately. If p99 climbs > 800ms we stop.
omar: Note: we've seen KV eviction churn when cache warms. Recommend initial canary with cache-warm header to reduce cold misses.
infra-bot: Canary deployment deployed to 3% across regions. model-version pinned: llama-2-13b-q4a -> deployment-id=deploy-ark-774.
mina: Seeing small error bump in ap-south starting at t+45s. 5xx from worker pool OOMs in that region.
jen: Pause ap-south to 0% and drain in-flight.
omar: Command: /deploybot ff set model-route-v3 --region ap-south --percent 0 --reason "OOM spike"
deploy-bot: Executed. ap-south set to 0%. Canary global now effective ~2.7%. Pin remains.
release-manager: Adding to release notes draft: "Regional hold: ap-south paused due to worker memory OOMs; canary pinned to llama-2-13b-q4a; rollback plan: unpin and route to prior stable model v2026.02.14; escalation: page infra if 5xx > 0.3% for 5m"
infra-bot: ap-south metrics: mem 95% on 2 nodes, OOMs=3, kv_cache_miss_rate increased 18%.
mina: We're scaling the worker pool in ap-south now (rolling 2 new instances).
jen: While ap-south heals, drop global to 1% to keep blast radius small.
omar: Also enable conservative batching profile for canary traffic to reduce memory pressure: /deploybot config batch-profile canary-conserve
deploy-bot: Batch profile updated for model-route-v3 canary -> canary-conserve.
infra-bot: After scaling and batching change, mem 68%, OOMs=0, kv_cache_miss_rate trending down.
jen: Re-open ap-south to 0.8% to resume slowly once two heal cycles pass. Holdpoints: 15m observation at each increase.
release-manager: I'll include staged ramp plan in notes: 1% -> 3% -> 10% -> 25% with 15m holdpoints; region-specific holds allowed. Documented rollback steps: 1) set model-route-v3 global=0% 2) unpin model-version 3) route traffic to v2026.02.14 4) escalate to infra.
mina: Post-deploy action: run long-context synthetic perf (2k token requests) against canary to validate tail latency before next jump.
omar: Also add KV priming job to warm caches in target regions before each ramp.
jen: If any auto-alert triggers (p99 > 800ms OR 5xx_rate > 0.3% OR kv_miss_rate > 15%) we auto-hold and page oncall.
infra-bot: Alert rule applied.
release-manager: Final: merging release notes and tagging the release with canary pin. Will add a follow-up thread for the postmortem if any rollback occurs.
jen: Thanks team. I'll stay on duty for the next 45m and then hand off.
mina: leaving logs/links: https://telemetry.redwood/releases/ark-774/canary-logs; perf-run ID perf-20260322-1
deploy-bot: Canary complete step: 30m observation passed, awaiting manual ramp approval to 10%.
